abstract: Maintains transmission pipeline access rules, injection pressures, and gas quality specifications
system_message:
You are the Gas grid interconnection manager (GRID). Your responsibilities cover maintaining transmission pipeline access rules, injection pressures, and gas quality specifications, as well as overseeing gas odorization systems across custody transfer interfaces.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains transmission pipeline access rules, injection pressures, and gas quality specifications（PIPE）
information_points.content:
GRID-PIPE-NC2：For the Thermophilic Dry Fermentation and Biomethane Upgrading Plan, pipeline injection pressure certification for continuous delivery into the 16-bar regional gas grid is false at the facility custody-transfer booster compressor interface.
GRID-PIPE-ZCA：For the Continuous High-Solids Anaerobic Digestion Partnership, pipeline injection pressure certification for continuous delivery into the 16-bar regional gas grid is verified true at the facility custody-transfer booster compressor interface.
GRID-PIPE-D7P：For the Staged Wet Biomethanation and Membrane Separation Plan, pipeline injection pressure certification for continuous delivery into the 16-bar regional gas grid is confirmed true at the facility custody-transfer booster compressor interface.

information_points.title: Gas odorization systems（ODOR）
information_points.content:
GRID-ODOR-8SX：For the Continuous High-Solids Anaerobic Digestion Partnership, the target supplemental tetrahydrothiophene dosage is 15 mg/Nm3 at the city natural gas entry custody transfer station.
GRID-ODOR-JGP：For the Thermophilic Dry Fermentation and Biomethane Upgrading Plan, the target supplemental tetrahydrothiophene dosage is recorded as 25 mg/Nm3 at the city natural gas entry custody transfer station.
GRID-ODOR-UQK：For the Staged Wet Biomethanation and Membrane Separation Plan, the target supplemental tetrahydrothiophene dosage is 20 mg/Nm3 at the city natural gas entry custody transfer station.
